title: Progress and cancellation in an MCP SDK v2 tool
notes: The v2 SDK (first stable 2.0.0 on 2026-07-27) split @modelcontextprotocol/sdk into @modelcontextprotocol/server and @modelcontextprotocol/client (both 2.4.0 here), removed server.tool(), and replaced the flat `extra` handler argument with a structured context: progress goes through ctx.mcpReq.notify with ctx.mcpReq._meta.progressToken, cancellation is ctx.mcpReq.signal, and InMemoryTransport is exported from the client and server packages. The naive solution uses the 1.x handler shape (raw-shape schema, extra.sendNotification, extra.signal) and fails the type check. The installed types declare the request context the handler gets: node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server/dist/mcp-BCJHyo7l.d.mts:2183 (ctx.mcpReq.signal) and node_modules/@modelcontextprotocol/server/dist/mcp-BCJHyo7l.d.mts:2204 (ctx.mcpReq.notify); they do not say that progress goes through notify with the progressToken from ctx.mcpReq._meta.
